name: Computational Ontology — SOCE analysis scaffold & agent wrapper
description: White-box, model-agnostic infrastructure for the ontological systematization of social objects: a 113-position vector encoder with missing-value masks, attributed-digraph comparison via a Weisfeiler-Lehman kernel, a delta0-delta4 classifier, and an agent wrapper that turns any AI system into a proposal-only second coder under a two-tier human-validation rule.

affiliation.name: LabOnt — Centre for Ontology, Università degli Studi di Torino
